selected_file.credit_text: Teletype Model 33 ASR at the Computer History Museum. Photo: Arnold Reinhold, 2014, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0). Scaled and pillarboxed.
selected_file.modifications_to_disclose: Scaled to 1440x1080 and pillarboxed to 16:9 on a dark ground.
selected_file.share_alike_note: In CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported, the 'avoidance of doubt' clause that makes synchronizing with moving images an Adaptation applies only where the Work is a musical work, performance or phonogram. Whether placing this still in the finished video creates an Adaptation (triggering ShareAlike on the video) or a Collection is a legal judgement this worker cannot make.
third_party_content_in_frame: A partially visible museum display card (Computer History Museum text, soft focus, cut off at the frame edge).
A partially visible yellow museum sign with unreadable dark shapes (top centre).
A decal reading 'TimeShare Corporation' on the machine, an incidental third-party name/logo.

why_blocked: R14 requires an item-specific decision, and no reviewer has recorded one.
ShareAlike consequences for the finished video are a legal question (see share_alike_note).
Incidental third-party museum signage and a company decal are visible; whether that matters for publication is a judgement call.
Editorial fit: the picture shows a Model 33 ASR, but Dartmouth's own October 1964 document names Model 35 consoles.

candidates_considered.title: ASR-33 at CHM.agr.jpg
candidates_considered.limitations: Model 33, not Dartmouth's documented Model 35. Museum unit with unknown history. 4:3 frame, so pillarboxed.

candidates_considered.status: preferred if permission is obtained; not acquired
candidates_considered.title: Dartmouth Alumni Magazine, Nov 1964, 'The Computer Revolution', pp. 26-29 photographs (students at College Hall input-output stations; Datanet-30; GE-235 console)
candidates_considered.rights: Masthead (p.3): 'All publication rights reserved', reprint only by permission of the editor. Publisher then: Dartmouth Secretaries Association. The site footer is also marked all rights reserved. Photographer credits for these interior photos were not legible in the 600px scans.
candidates_considered.limitations: Only 448x600 page thumbnails are served anonymously (larger sizes HTTP 403), which is unusable at 1080p. Needs permission and a high-resolution scan from the magazine or Dartmouth Libraries (Rauner). Not downloaded into the repository.

candidates_considered.limitations: The unit is badged 'Tymshare' and photographed at a sale, with a $600 price sticker and a printed sale sheet in frame. Also 1600x1200 only.

no_free_model_35_found: Commons has no Category:Teletype Model 35 (HTTP 404) and no Model 35 file in Category:Teletypes or Category:ASR-33 (checked 2026-09-15). The CHM catalog has ASR-35/KSR-35 records (102760446, 102662164) with no reproduction licence stated.
human_handoff: If a genuine 1964 Dartmouth terminal photo is wanted, someone must request permission and a high-resolution scan of the November 1964 Dartmouth Alumni Magazine pp. 26-29 photographs (or the originals, which may be in Dartmouth Libraries' Rauner Special Collections). No request was sent.
